## Ethical Approval and Informed Consent

This study involves secondary analysis of anonymised, publicly documented survey data collected by the OECD, and therefore did not require ethical approval or informed consent procedures by the author. Informed consent was obtained by the survey provider at the time of data collection.

## Data Availability Statement

The analysis uses the 2024 wave of the OECD Risks That Matter (RTM) survey. The data are available from the OECD upon request [https://oe.cd/rtm](https://oe.cd/rtm).

## Use of Artificial Intelligence

The author used an AI assistant (Claude, Anthropic) to support proofreading to improve English-language clarity for non-native speakers. All content was reviewed, verified and edited by the author, who takes full responsibility for the integrity, accuracy and originality of the work. No AI tool is listed as an author, and no AI tool was used to generate or analyse the data.
